name: Malachi
description: A nine-year-old devil child in a young man's body, son of the demon Abrigor, who travels Europe seeking objects of power while unknowingly releasing imprisoned demons.

name: Abrigor
description: A demon, father of Malachi, who gains the service of demons freed through Malachi's quests; he is vulnerable to volcanic glass.

name: Richard of Glastonbury
description: A diabolist monk raised by diabolist monks at Glastonbury Abbey, skilled in Incantation and Diablerie, who commits sins of blasphemy and idolatry while believing his Powers are not evil.

name: Nicolai
description: A Lithuanian pagan summoner and merchant with the Summoning Art, who summons and bargains with spirits for a price.

name: Moratamis
description: A person named as the target of an example Goetic command to slay him at Semita Errabunda.

name: Isabelle
description: A woman living at the covenant of Semita Errabunda, named in an example command of a Psychomachia maleficium.

name: Releganta of Flambeau
description: A Spanish False Maga from Leon whose Gift is corrupted by the Infernal; lustful, practicing Chthonic Magic and Hex, and apprentice of the infernalist Rasus of Flambeau.

name: Rasus of Flambeau
description: A magus of House Flambeau and secret infernalist who seduced Raquel and trained her as Releganta; he deals with ghosts and spirits.

name: Rudolphus of House Bonisagus
description: One of the most infamous Venatores, Wizard's Marched in 1151 A.D. for persecuting demons so much that they turned their wrath on the Order.

name: Solomon
description: Biblical figure whose secret arts are believed by many to be a source of the Ars Goetia.

name: Witch of Endor
description: Biblical figure whose secret arts are believed by many to be a source of the Ars Goetia.

name: The Devil
description: The lord of Hell who takes his due from failed infernalists and whom diabolists declare belief in when renouncing God.

name: Demon
description: Infernal spirits with corporeal bodies of pure spirit, summoned, bound, commanded, and hunted in the Infernal and Goetic rules; they have Infernal Might and Hierarchy Scores.

name: Ghost
description: Spirit of the dead; a diabolist whose body is destroyed may become one, and Goetic Mastery applies to spells targeting ghosts.

name: Hobgoblin
description: A creature often used as the form of the phantasmal being sent into a victim's mind by a Phantasm maleficium.

name: Faerie shade
description: An incorporeal being with Might that may be targeted by spells with Goetic Mastery.

name: Semita Errabunda
description: A covenant named in example commands of Infernal effects and Goetic Arts.

name: Glastonbury Abbey
description: Abbey where Richard of Glastonbury was abandoned and raised by diabolist monks.

name: Lithuania
description: Baltic region where Nicolai grew up in a pagan village destroyed by Christian knights.

name: Kiev
description: City where Nicolai met the wandering merchant-summoner who became his teacher.

name: Leon
description: Region of northwestern Iberia where Releganta grew up in a small village.

name: Hell
description: The abode of the Infernal whose power infernalists draw on and which claims souls of failed maleficia casters.

name: Infernal Realm
description: The realm of Hell whose power fuels maleficia, Goetic Arts and Infernal Powers.

name: Divine Realm
description: The realm of God; Diablerie cannot affect it and phantasms are dispelled by it.

name: Magic Realm
description: The realm of Magic; black magic is metaphysically still part of it.

name: Faerie Realm
description: Supernatural realm whose creatures and effects Diablerie can affect.

name: Dominion
description: The Divine aura, in which phantasms cannot survive and where scouring tends to turn up demons.

name: House Flambeau
description: Hermetic House of Releganta and her master Rasus.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House in which diabolism was discovered in the early 900s.

name: House Bonisagus
description: Hermetic House of the infamous Venator Rudolphus.

name: House Quaesitor
description: Hermetic House referenced in connection with dealings with devils.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of magi which prohibits dealing with demons and has no official position on demon-hunters.

name: Quaesitores
description: Hermetic investigators who watch magi with demon-focused spells and have reservations about the Venatores.

name: Venatores
description: A loose group of demon-hunting magi from any House who pass their knowledge through an advanced apprenticeship; poorly regarded in the Order.

name: Sho'elim 'ov
description: Ancient Jewish summoners and necromancers, 'spirit borrowers', considered the first sorcerers.

name: Infernalist
description: A practitioner of Infernal powers such as the maleficia.

name: Diabolist
description: A Mythic Companion who has renounced God and sworn to Satan in exchange for Infernal blessings and the maleficia.

name: Sorcerer
description: A practitioner of the Goetic Arts, strongly stigmatized in Mythic Europe.

name: Summoner
description: A Mythic Companion versed in the Goetic Art of Summoning, often living as a hermit with ghostly servants and a ghostly warder.

name: Mythic Companion
description: A companion aligned with a supernatural power who takes twice as many Virtue points as Flaws.

name: Chthonic Magus
description: A magus attuned to both Magical and Infernal auras through Chthonic Magic.

name: Energumen
description: A human possessed by a demon, targeted by Exorcise the Filthy Spirit.

name: Demon-Hunter
description: Magi who push the Code to seek out and destroy demons.

name: Maleficia
description: Infernal effects resembling Hermetic spells, cast with a Method plus a Power: stress die + Characteristic + Method + Power + aura.

name: Unholy Methods
description: The Infernal 'Techniques' of maleficia, Debauchery and Incantation, describing what the infernalist must do.

name: Unholy Powers
description: The six Infernal Powers combined with Methods to describe maleficia effects.

name: Warping Points
description: Points gained from failed maleficia and supernatural effects, which may trigger Vituperation or Twilight.

name: Vituperation
description: The Infernal counterpart of Twilight, checked when an infernalist gains two or more Warping Points.

name: Hierarchy Score
description: A measure of an infernalist's or demon's repute in Hell, which protects against failed maleficia and modifies Goetic totals.

name: Confidence
description: Confidence Score and Points, spent to boost maleficia and gained through sin or ablation.

name: Infernal Blessing
description: A Diablerie effect of Forsaken Duration granting Infernal power, lost upon redemption.

name: Infernal Curse
description: Maledictions, usually of Forsaken Duration, that remain until dispelled.

name: Crossroads (Range)
description: Infernal Range letting the caster affect a target on a road intersecting his own; equal to Range Voice.

name: Cursed (Duration)
description: Infernal conditional Duration that triggers an effect under a stated uncommon circumstance; equal to Duration Sun.

name: Forsaken (Duration)
description: Infernal Duration lasting as long as the target is tainted by the Infernal; canceled by repentance; equal to Duration Year.

name: Passion (Target)
description: Infernal Target affecting a group through their passions; equal to Target Group.

name: Ceremony
description: Group casting of maleficia where participants pool Method scores.

name: Sacrifice
description: Ritual sacrifice giving a bonus to maleficia and Goetic effects.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power used to boost maleficia and spells.

name: Infernal Vis
description: Vis tainted by the Infernal, usable by infernalists; comes as vis infesta, sordida and prava.

name: Vis Infesta
description: The least corrupted grade of Infernal vis.

name: Vis Sordida
description: A middle grade of Infernal vis.

name: Vis Prava
description: The most corrupted grade of Infernal vis.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance that maleficia and spells must penetrate.

name: Penetration
description: Measure of an effect overcoming Magic Resistance, used by maleficia and Goetic Arts.

name: Arcane Connection
description: A sympathetic link needed to affect distant creatures or targets.

name: True Name
description: A demon's name, which serves as an Arcane Connection for summoning it.

name: Aura
description: Supernatural aura bonus to maleficia and Goetic totals.

name: Infernal Aura
description: Aura of the Infernal realm, which Diablerie can create and Psychomachia can tarnish.

name: Infernal Regio
description: A regio of the Infernal that Diablerie can create.

name: Tarnished Aura
description: An Infernal aura imbued with a personality trait.

name: Might
description: Supernatural power score of creatures, used as the Target Level of Goetic Arts.

name: Might Pool
description: A creature's pool of Might Points, restorable or reducible by effects.

name: Possession
description: A demon's Power to inhabit a human body.

name: Scouring
description: Summoning a non-specific spirit from the surrounding area.

name: Summoning Circle
description: A circle drawn by a sorcerer to hold a summoned spirit.

name: Bargaining with Demons
description: The dangerous practice of trading with summoned demons for aid.

name: Ablation Points
description: Points gained by Ablating a spirit, spent on Confidence, Capability, Health, Immortality, Insight, Knowledge, Might, Power or Vis.

name: Ars Goetia
description: 'The howling art'; the four Goetic Arts of sorcery, supposedly from Solomon and the Witch of Endor.

name: Nigromancy
description: Black magic concerned with the Infernal; still part of the Magic realm.

name: Code of Hermes
description: Hermetic law forbidding dealing with demons.

name: Peripheral Code
description: Hermetic legal rulings, both for and against demon-hunters.

name: Wizard's March
description: Hermetic sentence of death and destruction, applied to Rudolphus in 1151.

name: Spell Mastery
description: Ability to master spells, with special abilities.

name: Apotropaic Mastery
description: Spell mastery ability adding Mastery Score x Hierarchy Score to spells targeting Infernal Might.

name: Goetic Mastery
description: Spell mastery ability adding a Goetic Art to casting totals for spells targeting spirits.

name: Apotropaic Spells
description: Hermetic spells for combating demons, considered questionable by many magi.

name: Infernal Magic
description: Forms of Hermetic magic aligned with the Infernal: Chthonic, Goetic, and False Magic.

name: Goetic Magic
description: Adapting the Ars Goetia to Hermetic magic via Rego and Vim.

name: False Magic
description: Magic from a False Gift, corrupted by Infernal powers.

name: False Gift
description: A version of The Gift corrupted by the Infernal, leading to Vituperation instead of Twilight.

name: Twilight
description: Hermetic magical experience from Warping, replaced by Vituperation for the False Gift.

name: Infernal Traditions
description: Groups of infernalists (covens, sabbats, cults) with shared Favored Abilities.

name: Favored Abilities
description: Four Supernatural Abilities in which an Infernal tradition specializes.

name: Infernal Reputation
description: Reputation among demons, gained through ablation, binding or commanding.

name: Profaning the Holy
description: Process that allows Divine vis to be used by infernalists.

name: Wizard's Sigil
description: A magus's characteristic magical signature; Releganta's is a feeling of emptiness.

name: Familiar
description: A bonded spirit; a chthonic or Goetic magus may bind a demon or spirit as familiar.

name: Magical Focus
description: A focus doubling the lowest Art; stacks with Chthonic Magic.

name: Mortal Sin
description: State of a person whose death secures a soul for Hell.

name: Laboratory
description: Lab rules used for binding spells into spirits.

name: Debauchery
description: Unholy Method requiring the infernalist to corrupt her body through sin, suffering Fatigue or a Wound; uses Stamina.

name: Incantation
description: Unholy Method of chanting words of power, costing a Confidence Point; uses Communication and allows use of vis.

name: Consumption
description: Unholy Power drawing on the life and health of living beings to twist flesh or steal life.

name: Diablerie
description: Unholy Power over supernatural realms and creatures, used to summon, resist and command demons.

name: Effusion
description: Unholy Power letting infernalists affect the elements unnaturally without creating anything.

name: Malediction
description: Unholy Power of curses, general via Incantation and destructive via Debauchery.

name: Phantasm
description: Unholy Power of illusions and perception, dispelled by the Divine.

name: Psychomachia
description: Unholy Power over mind and emotions, making targets want to sin.

name: Infernal Lore
description: Knowledge of the Infernal, added to seasonal maleficia rituals.

name: Sense Holiness and Unholiness
description: Supernatural Ability to tell good from evil.

name: Concentration
description: Ability used to maintain summoning circles and concentration.

name: Bargain
description: Ability used in contested rolls when bargaining with spirits.

name: Chthonic Magic
description: Supernatural Ability/Hermetic Virtue of low magic associated with underworld gods, attuning the magus to Magic and Infernal auras.

name: Hex
description: Supernatural Ability of cursing, possessed by Releganta.

name: Magic Theory
description: Ability for which Chthonic Magic may substitute in dark lab work.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic protective ability; a sorcerer can lower his ward as a magus does his Parma.

name: Second Sight
description: Ability to see through magical and faerie illusions.

name: Magic Lore
description: Knowledge of the magic realm, possessed by Nicolai.

name: Artes Liberales
description: Academic Ability; unholy Methods may substitute for it in chthonic rituals.

name: Philosophiae
description: Academic Ability; unholy Methods may substitute for it in chthonic rituals.

name: Theology
description: Academic Ability, corrupted in Richard of Glastonbury.

name: Teaching
description: Ability, corrupted in Richard of Glastonbury.

name: Church Lore
description: Knowledge of the Church.

name: Civil and Canon Law
description: Legal knowledge Ability.

name: Area Lore
description: Knowledge of an area, used in scouring.

name: Order of Hermes Lore
description: Knowledge of the Order.

name: Craft Hex Toys
description: Releganta's craft of making cursing wax figurines.

name: Craft Amulets
description: Supernatural Ability that eases making angelic amulets.

name: Leadership
description: Ability used with Command the Vile Spirit.

name: Music
description: Ability that could power a variant of Incantation using dissonant songs.

name: Finesse
description: Hermetic Ability.

name: Latin
description: Language Ability.

name: Summoning
description: Goetic Art of drawing a spirit into the sorcerer's presence within a circle.

name: Ablating
description: Goetic Art of tearing essence from a spirit, permanently reducing its Might; always an Infernal Power.

name: Binding
description: Goetic Art of changing a spirit so it becomes part of a person or thing.

name: Commanding
description: Goetic Art of issuing a command a spirit must obey.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Form; maleficia count as Vim effects; demon-targeting spells use Vim.

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Technique used to ward and command demons.

name: Perdo
description: Hermetic Technique used to destroy demons.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Technique used in Creo Vim demon spells.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Technique used in Intellego Vim demon spells.

name: Muto
description: Hermetic Technique used in Muto Vim binding spells.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Form; Releganta is Puissant in it.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Form.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Form, requisite for Early Punishment for the Sinful Witch.

name: Diabolist (Virtue)
description: Free Special Virtue required of diabolists.

name: Summoner (Virtue)
description: Free Special Virtue required of Summoners.

name: The Gift
description: Supernatural Virtue enabling magic; can be cursed or duplicated as a False Power.

name: Arcane Lore
description: Minor General Virtue option for diabolists and summoners.

name: Student of (Infernal)
description: Minor General Virtue option for diabolists and summoners.

name: Wise One
description: Minor Social Status Virtue option for diabolists and summoners.

name: Demon Blood
description: Major Supernatural Virtue.

name: Book Learner
description: Virtue of Richard of Glastonbury.

name: Educated
description: Virtue that cannot be granted by Infernal blessing.

name: Privileged Upbringing
description: Virtue that cannot be granted by Infernal blessing.

name: Good Teacher
description: Virtue of Richard of Glastonbury.

name: Great Communication
description: Virtue of Richard of Glastonbury.

name: Great Intelligence
description: Virtue granted to Richard as Infernal Power.

name: Self-Confident
description: Virtue.

name: Improved Characteristics
description: Virtue.

name: Affinity with (Ability)
description: Virtue; binding a spirit lets a character learn its Abilities as if with Affinity.

name: Puissant (Ability)
description: Virtue granting bonus to an Ability or Art.

name: Intuition
description: Virtue of Nicolai.

name: Magic Sensitivity
description: Virtue of Nicolai.

name: Sharp Ears
description: Virtue of Nicolai.

name: Well-Traveled
description: Virtue of Nicolai.

name: Wilderness Sense
description: Virtue of Nicolai.

name: Good Characteristics
description: Virtue for points spent on Characteristics.

name: Diedne Magic
description: Hermetic Virtue; with Chthonic Magic the lowest Art is tripled.

name: Vengeful Powers
description: Flaw causing evil consequences whenever Infernal powers are used virtuously.

name: Tainted with Evil
description: Minor Flaw.

name: Diabolic Past
description: Major Story Flaw.

name: Dark Secret
description: Flaw magi with Infernal Power should take.

name: Monastic Vows
description: Flaw.

name: Delusion
description: Flaw; Richard believes his Powers are not evil.

name: Proud
description: Flaw.

name: Corrupted Abilities
description: Flaw gained through Infernal Warping.

name: False Power
description: Flaw making supernatural powers appear unholy; required for the False Gift.

name: Pagan
description: Flaw of Nicolai.

name: Outcast
description: Flaw.

name: Oversensitive
description: Flaw.

name: Social Handicap
description: Flaw.

name: Infamous Master
description: Flaw.

name: Lecherous
description: Flaw.

name: Overconfident
description: Flaw.

name: These shall give their power and strength unto the beast
description: Debauchery/Consumption 20 ritual transferring Strength.

name: A golden cup, full of abominations
description: Debauchery/Consumption 25 impregnating a woman with a man's seed.

name: Break the body, bend the will / One can injure, one can kill
description: Incantation/Consumption 30 healing a target by wounding a victim.

name: Cast away your mortal soul / And keep it safe in mortal bowl
description: Incantation/Consumption 50 transferring the caster's soul into a vis-containing vessel.

name: And he causeth all to receive a mark
description: Debauchery/Diablerie 25 making an object an Arcane Connection to a creature.

name: The image of the beast should speak
description: Debauchery/Diablerie 35 summoning a demon's image.

name: And the dragon gave him his power
description: Incantation/Diablerie 40 Forsaken granting a Minor Virtue.

name: The cage of every unclean and hateful bird
description: Incantation/Diablerie 50 enslaving a supernatural creature.

name: The stone prepared, his gift to grant / With foulest craft he does enchant
description: Incantation/Effusion General preparing an object to hold maleficia.

name: Darkness has power over all things general / Weather and wind and all courses variable
description: Debauchery/Effusion 20 flying winds.

name: Roll, you clouds, and thunder cry / And strike with flames from empty sky
description: Debauchery/Effusion 25 thunderstorm.

name: I conjure this, by foul decree / In its same likeness unto me
description: Incantation/Effusion 25 summoning an object to the hand.

name: As the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers
description: Debauchery/Malediction 15 Medium Wound.

name: The student must be forced to learn / and thus the worm begins to turn
description: Incantation/Malediction 20 bad-luck curse.

name: Therefore shall all her plagues come in one day
description: Debauchery/Malediction 30 Cursed death curse.

name: By evening ash and morning dew I send your charms away from you
description: Incantation/Malediction 50 removing a Major Virtue.

name: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles
description: Incantation/Phantasm 10 seeing through Infernal deception.

name: Summon shapes of lustful need / And swiftly form a ghostly steed
description: Debauchery/Phantasm 20 phantasmal horse.

name: I saw three unclean spirits, like frogs, out of the mouth of the dragon
description: Incantation/Phantasm 20 ominous vision.

name: To stir the spirit, heart and fear / A shadow phantom hunts in here
description: Level 40 maleficium sending a phantasmal creature into a victim's mind.

name: Babylon the great is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils
description: Debauchery/Psychomachia 15 tarnishing an Infernal aura.

name: And the men had repented not of their deeds
description: Incantation/Psychomachia 10 sensing dominant emotion.

name: They shall make the whore desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh
description: Debauchery/Psychomachia 45 group emotion.

name: I will make them of the synagogue of Satan; I will make them worship before thy feet
description: Incantation/Psychomachia 50 group command.

name: Demon's Eternal Oblivion
description: Standard demon-hunter spell stripping a demon of its Might.

name: Circular Ward Against Demons
description: Standard demon-hunter ward that can also trap demons.

name: Watching Ward
description: Spell used to trigger a prepared Circular Ward.

name: Ward Against Demons
description: Arcane circle spell in which a summoned demon can be forced to appear.

name: Fanning the Infernal Flames
description: CrVi Gen restoring a demon's Might Pool; known among infernalist magi.

name: Plucking the Hair from the Billy Goat's Chin
description: CrVi 20 creating a temporary Arcane Connection to a demon.

name: Sulfurous Whispers
description: InVi 30 speaking with a demon via Arcane Connection.

name: Early Punishment for the Sinful Witch
description: MuVi(Ig) Gen destroying an Infernal effect on an infernalist in white flame.

name: The Wicked Jar
description: MuVi Gen binding a demon into a sealed jar.

name: Bind the Devil's Hands
description: PeVi Gen hindering Infernal Powers in a room.

name: Exorcise the Filthy Spirit
description: PeVi Gen reducing a possessing demon's Possession Might Pool.

name: Lash of the Chastened Servant
description: PeVi 15 removing 5 Might from a demon; incurs suspicion of diabolism.

name: Adjuration of the Hell-Sworn Spirit
description: ReVi 35 summoning a demon via its True Name.

name: Cleanse the Verminous Vis
description: ReVi 15 transferring Infernal vis, reducing but not removing its taint.

name: Command the Vile Spirit
description: ReVi 20 forcing a demon to obey.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Spell ineligible for Apotropaic Mastery.

name: Lifting the Dangling Puppet
description: ReCo 15 spell known by Releganta.

name: Pilum of Fire
description: CrIg 20 spell known by Releganta.

name: Loss of But a Moment's Memory
description: PeMe 15 spell known by Releganta.

name: Blessing of Childlike Bliss
description: PeMe 25 spell known by Releganta.

name: The Call to Slumber
description: ReMe 10 spell known by Releganta.

name: Confusion of the Numbed Will
description: ReMe 15 spell known by Releganta.

name: Wind of Mundane Silence
description: PeVi 20 spell known by Releganta.

name: Amulet bearing the sigils of angels
description: Shape/material bonus item giving +7 to ward and banish demons.

name: Hex Toys
description: Releganta's wax figurines crafted into Arcane Connections to punish people.

name: Phylactery
description: Shape/material bonus +5 protecting the wearer.
